components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The primary action — near-black stone, NOT blue, to keep the accent rare.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; padding: 6px 12px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 7px; background: #1c1917; color: #fafaf9; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #292524; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.55 0.16 250); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action — white surface, hairline border.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { font-family: -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; padding: 6px 12px; border: 1px solid #ebe9e6; border-radius: 7px; background: #ffffff; color: #1c1917; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #f5f5f4; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.55 0.16 250); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Tool (active state)
components.description: Signature tool-palette cell. Shows the canonical active treatment: blue wash fill + blue edge + blue glyph, with a mono keycap.
components.css: .ds-tool-rail { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; padding: 2px; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #ebe9e6; border-radius: 9px; box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(28,25,23,0.06); } .ds-tool { position: relative; width: 32px; height: 32px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: #78716c; cursor: pointer; padding: 0; } .ds-tool:hover { color: #57534e; } .ds-tool-active { background: oklch(0.96 0.04 250); border-color: oklch(0.85 0.06 250); color: oklch(0.4 0.16 250); } .ds-tool-key { position: absolute; right: 3px; bottom: 1px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 8.5px; font-weight: 500; color: #a8a29e; } .ds-tool-active .ds-tool-key { color: oklch(0.5 0.14 250); }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Mono-valued segmented control; active segment lifts to white with an accent edge.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; padding: 2px; background: #f5f5f4; border: 1px solid #ebe9e6; border-radius: 7px; } .ds-seg-btn { min-width: 34px; height: 26px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 5px; background: transparent; color: #78716c; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 11px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-seg-btn:hover:not(.ds-seg-active) { color: #1c1917; } .ds-seg-active { background: #ffffff; border-color: oklch(0.85 0.06 250); color: oklch(0.4 0.16 250); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(28,25,23,0.06); }

components.name: Search Input (focused)
components.description: Field with the canonical focus treatment — accent edge + 2px wash ring, no glow.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 180px; height: 30px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.85 0.06 250); border-radius: 7px; background: #fafaf9; color: #1c1917; font-family: -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12.5px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px oklch(0.96 0.04 250); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #78716c; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; }

components.name: Style Panel
components.description: The only card-like surface in the app — a floating, draggable inspector. Hairline-divided sections, uppercase micro-labels, swatch row.
components.html:
Rectangle
Fill
components.css: .ds-panel { width: 232px; padding: 12px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #ebe9e6; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(28,25,23,0.06); font-family: -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-panel-head { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.2px; color: #57534e; } .ds-panel-sec { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 9px; border-top: 1px solid #ebe9e6; padding-top: 12px; } .ds-panel-label { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.3px; text-transform: uppercase; color: #a8a29e; } .ds-swatches { display: flex; gap: 5px; } .ds-swatch { width: 18px; height: 18px; border-radius: 5px; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.12); cursor: pointer; padding: 0; } .ds-swatch-on { box-shadow: 0 0 0 1.5px #ffffff, 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.55 0.16 250); }

components.name: Keycap
components.description: Inline shortcut hint — reinforces the keyboard-first posture.
components.html: Hold Shift to draw a straight edge
components.css: .ds-hint { font-family: -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11.5px; color: #a8a29e; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; } .ds-kbd { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 1px 6px; border: 1px solid #ebe9e6; border-radius: 4px; background: #ffffff; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 10.5px; color: #57534e; }

narrative.overview: Épure is a precise instrument, not an app. The whole surface behaves like a drafting table under good light: a flat warm-stone field, a snapping grid, exact orthogonal lines, and a small set of mechanical controls that sit on the work rather than around it. The system is built from two clearly separated worlds: the chrome is a quiet, light, warm-neutral instrument (a stone ramp up to pure white floating surfaces, a single blue accent for state, and a dark code-editor slab), while the diagram content is a separate vivid ten-hue palette the user authors into the drawing. These two palettes never trade roles. It explicitly rejects generic AI-SaaS surfaces, playful hand-sketched styling, and heavy enterprise CAD chrome.
keyCharacteristics: Two-world color: muted warm-stone chrome holding a vivid diagram palette.
One accent (blue) used only for active/focused state — never decoration.
Hairline-and-tonal depth; soft shadow reserved for UI that truly floats over the canvas.
Monospace for anything mechanical (coordinates, keys, code, file names).
Compact, exact metrics: 1px rules, 10–13px type, 28–44px control heights.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: The blue accent appears only to signal state — an active tool, a focused field, a hovered resize handle, a selected segment. Never a fill for emphasis, never a gradient, never decoration. Its rarity is what makes 'active' legible at a glance.

rules.name: The Two-Worlds Rule
rules.body: Chrome colors (stone + one blue) and diagram colors (the ten saturated hues) never swap jobs. UI never borrows a diagram hue for emphasis; a node never gets painted in the UI accent.

rules.name: The Mono-for-Mechanism Rule
rules.body: If a value is a coordinate, a percentage, a keyboard shortcut, a file path, or code, it is set in JetBrains Mono. Prose and labels are sans. The font tells you whether a thing is machine or language.

rules.name: The Float-Earns-Shadow Rule
rules.body: A surface gets a shadow only if it floats over the canvas. Docked chrome (header, footer, tab bar, resize handle) is flat and separated by a hairline.

dos: Do keep the blue accent rare — active and focused states only. Emphasis elsewhere comes from weight, the stone ramp, or a hairline.
Do set every coordinate, percentage, keycap, file name, and code value in JetBrains Mono.
Do separate surfaces with the tonal ramp (#ecebe7 → #fafaf9 → #ffffff) and 1px hairlines; add a Card shadow only when the element floats over the canvas.
Do keep the diagram's ten saturated hues for diagram content only; keep chrome in stone + one blue.
Do hold targets exact and compact — 32px tool cells, 28/38px dock controls, 10–13px type — and verify body text clears 4.5:1 (placeholder included).
Do give every interactive element a visible focus state and a prefers-reduced-motion fallback; transitions are short and ease-out, never bouncy.
donts: Don't ship generic AI-SaaS surfaces — no gradient hero, no glassmorphism, no decorative blur, no big-number metric template, no identical card grids.
Don't drift into playful/hand-sketched (Excalidraw) chrome, or into heavy enterprise CAD chrome (stacked toolbars, ribbons, modal soup).
Don't use the blue accent as a fill for emphasis, a gradient, or decoration. It marks state, nothing else.
Don't paint UI chrome with a diagram hue, or paint a node/edge with the UI accent. The two palettes never swap roles.
Don't add border-left/border-right colored stripes on panels, list items, or alerts; use full hairlines, tonal fills, or an icon instead.
Don't put a shadow on docked chrome (header, footer, tab bar) — a hairline does that job.
